text:
Riley: FYI customer @Acme is seeing intermittent 429s and higher tail latency on their Dedicated pool since last night. They report steady 45-55 qps but spikes to 100 qps for a few seconds, then 429s.
Mara: got it. are they on reserved pool or dedicated w/ shared burst? which SKU?
Riley: reserved pool, 4-GPU dedicated, reserved qps 60, burst window 20s per docs. customer says bursts are being rejected earlier than expected.
Devon: any auth errors in the logs? 429 vs 401 distinction matters.
Riley: mostly 429 + some 502 during the same window. no auth 401s in app logs, but customer mentioned an API key rotation yesterday around 02:10 UTC.
Linus: quick checklist: tokenbucket state, refill clock skew between edge and pool manager, proxy retry logic.
SupportBot: <link to incident 1718504321> Incident created: "reserved pool premature throttling". Assigned: @Mara, @Devon.
Mara: can we get the pool token metrics for customer_id=acme_corp: token_count, refill_ts, last_debit_ts for the window? Also collect edge gateway logs for X-RateLimit headers.
Devon: pulling metrics now. early look shows token_count dropped to 0 at 02:11 and did not refill for ~35s (should have refilled within 20s window). comparing system clocks shows no NTP drift.
Sam: could billing/quotas have cut them off? Billing had an unfinished invoice yesterday.
BillingBot: alert: invoice 2209 for acme_corp unpaid; billing did not auto-cut capacity. No explicit cap applied from billing service.
Linus: attaching a small repro we ran that mimics their QPS pattern:

```
# warm 1m @ 50 qps then 15s @ 120 qps burst
wrk -t4 -c100 -d70s --script=burst.lua http://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate
```

Linus: results: 502 and 429s during the burst; proxy logs show repeated tokenbucket rejections with reason 'stale-refill'.
Mara: 'stale-refill' implies the pool manager ignored the refill because its last_refill_ts > current_refill_ts (clock or stale cache). Any recent deploy to pool-manager or edge-proxy?
Devon: there was a pool-manager rollback 02:05 UTC yesterday (small patch to concurrency accounting). Could be related.
Riley: customer impact: 2.4 hours of degraded SLO, some requests hitting fallback logic in their app. They flagged as P2.
Sam: immediate mitigation options: 1) raise reserved qps to 80 temporarily, 2) enable hosted-fallthrough (route overflow to hosted while we fix), 3) ask customer to soften burst pattern (backoff).
Mara: deployed a safe mitigation: enabled hosted-fallthrough for acme_corp to reduce errors while we debug (no billing changes). Monitor.
Devon: root cause hypothesis: pool-manager rollback reintroduced a race where concurrent refill updates could be ignored if processing out of order. Under a sudden burst the refill op was stomped by a later stale state, leaving the tokenbucket empty longer than window.
Linus: repro steps to validate locally:
1) run two parallel workers that race update /pool/{id}/refill with same base_ts
2) observe sequence where stale write wins due to DB write ordering
3) run same wrk burst and confirm 429s

Mara: suggested fix: add monotonic refill sequence numbers and CAS update in pool-store; add a 100ms jitter to refill processing queue to reduce write contention.
Devon: scheduled hotfix PR, test coverage for race, and a canary to dedicated pools in eu-west-1. ETA for deploy: 6h.
SupportBot: noted: action items -> Mara (monitor & communicate), Devon (fix PR), Linus (repro + test harness), Sam (coordinate customer mitigation).
Riley: customer notified of temporary hosted-fallthrough and ETA for fix. they asked for postmortem and invoice review.
BillingBot: will queue manual invoice follow-up; no immediate billing caps changed.
Mara: follow-ups: add alert when reserved_pool_headroom < 10% for >30s, add a runbook entry for enabling hosted-fallthrough, and verify rate-limit headers are surfaced to customers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset). Owner: Mara. ETA: 3 days.
Devon: will link PR here once ready.
Linus: leaving logs snippet of proxy response headers we saw during repro:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1670003376
X-RateLimit-Reason: tokenbucket_stale_refill
```

Sam: good notes. closing loop: once hotfix is live we'll remove hosted-fallthrough and monitor for 24h before declaring resolved.
Riley: thanks everyone. keep this thread updated with PR link and postmortem draft."
